hero.title: Join a movement moving creative culture forward
hero.subtitle: We bring together culture, creativity, and technology to give creatives and underrepresented voices across the DACH region the visibility they deserve. And behind the scenes, we live what we stand for: diversity, openness, courage, and true collaboration.

opportunities.title: Open Opportunities
opportunities.subtitle: If you're the owner of an active brain, interesting thoughts, and a good soul, we would like to hear from you.

values.title: Diversity
values.text: Diversity isn't a slogan. It's who we are, in our team, our partners, and our ideas.

values.title: Authenticity always
values.text: We don't do façades. We want real people with real stories and perspectives.

values.title: Innovation with purpose
values.text: Technology is only exciting when it creates change. We use it to make representation visible, not to replace it.

values.title: Community over competition
values.text: We believe in collaboration, exchange, and support, because real change only happens together.

teams.title: Product, Design, & Data
teams.text: We are building the platform of record that powers content creation and distribution for brands globally. Our mission is to serve the creator economy and provide them with the best place on earth to do what they love—create.

teams.title: Customer Experience
teams.text: We are the secret sauce of #paid–creating and enabling customer and creator experiences that deliver results, impact, and most importantly, joy.

teams.title: Sales
teams.text: Our goal is to educate brands and agencies how to think about creator marketing. We do deep discovery, tailoring our offering to help clients hit their objectives.

teams.title: People
teams.text: People are the Soul of our company. We live this value by sourcing the best humans and then providing the best environment for our people to have career defining moments.

teams.title: Finance
teams.text: Our Finance team works to build processes and policies that ensure accurate and timely information so that our other teams are supported to make informed business decisions.

teams.title: Media, Analytics & Strategy
teams.text: We have a passion for analytics and all things digital. We find solutions for sophisticated challenges that span across creative, strategic and technical and analytical dimensions.

teams.title: Marketing
teams.text: Our goal is to build a brand that people can't get off their minds. Together, we strive to create memorable moments with brands and creators.

teams.title: Engineering
teams.text: We design tools and features that create the foundation for brands and creators to collaborate together. We define the future of #paid and look into ways we can scale and share the future of the Creator Economy.

careerWhy.mainTitle: We envision a world were creators are passionate about building something that matters
careerWhy.subtitle: Huerray is a space for people who love ideas, who believe in creativity with purpose, and who want to make real change happen.
careerWhy.description1: Whether your background is in marketing, tech, design, business development, or community. Huerray is a space for people who love ideas, who believe in creativity with purpose, and who want to make real change happen. whether your background is in marketing, tech, design, business development, or community. We care less about titles and more about who you are, what you stand for, and the energy you bring. We're growing, organically, intentionally, and with purpose.
careerWhy.description2: We're always open to meeting people who share our vision and want to help shape it.
